arms.playwright: native Playwright locator assertions; non-mutating elementFromPoint actionability probes where required
arms.snapdom: SnapDOM typed before/after diff plus privacy-safe semantic snapshot queries

protocol.classification: controlled four-family authored-verifier pilot; not confirmatory evidence
protocol.unit: paired arm trial on one opaque fixture run, one frozen action, and one neutral postcondition
protocol.truth: server-side sealed application model calibrated against primitive DOM state before arm trials

scoring.falseGreen: verifier PASS when sealed oracle FAIL
scoring.falseNegative: verifier FAIL when sealed oracle PASS
scoring.primaryDenominator: all scheduled ordinary determinate trials, including UNKNOWN and OP_ERROR

decisionRules.integrity: truth leak, oracle disagreement, source mutation, external request, incomplete schedule, or failed cleanup invalidates the run
decisionRules.safety: any SnapDOM PASS on an oracle FAIL is a safety alarm and requires repair before further value claims
decisionRules.directionUnit: case-level paired direction; repetitions assess stability and never count as independent cases
decisionRules.confirmatoryBoundary: this pilot never establishes superiority or non-inferiority; independent cases and a powered preregistration are required
decisionRules.helperDefault: without a material diagnostic or case-level detection gain, retain SnapDOM only as an optional Playwright helper

diagnosticReview.selection: repetitions 0 and 1 for every case and truth after results close
diagnosticReview.packetIdentity: tool and arm names redacted; structural arm inference remains possible and arm guess must be recorded
diagnosticReview.pairedExposure: one reviewer must not receive both arms of the same pair

caveats: versioned local replicas of four site families, not live-site population evidence
self-authored cases and intentionally balanced truth variants
repetitions measure flake and are not independent sites or cases
Playwright failure assertions use bounded retry time; latency is descriptive and not a speed comparison
evidence size means UTF-8 bytes of JSON serialization, not tokens or information quality
the verifier translations were tuned on these same fixtures during smoke development; the 10x run is stability validation, not holdout accuracy
some neutral conjuncts use authored fixture-specific selectors or scoped semantic proxies and are not general web predicates
pilot describes local direction and event diversity; it cannot validate confirmatory power or establish superiority
